name: ZCA_ORCH_RT_STAGES
description: Contains the list of stages in a given Orchestration object and their run time status in the transactional object's context.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration stages runtime object.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Order in which the Stages to be executed/shown back in UI.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STAGE_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier or alternate key of the Orchestration stages runtime object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration stage object.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestrations object.

columns.name: RUNTIME_STATUS
columns.description: Runtime status of the Orchestration stages. Possible values are NOTSTARTED, ACTIVE, SKIPPED, COMPLETED, etc.

columns.name: ORCHESTRATION_ASSOC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Orchestration association.

columns.name: TOTAL_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of total objectives present for the current stage context.

columns.name: COMPLETED_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of completed objectives for the current stage context.

columns.name: SKIPPED_NOTHELPFUL_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of skipped or nothelpful objectives for the current stage context.

columns.name: PENDING_OBJS_CNT
columns.description: Number of pending objectives for the current stage context.

columns.name: STAGE_START_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the date and time when the stage execution is being started.

columns.name: STAGE_END_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the date and time when the stage execution is being ended.

columns.name: CURRENT_STAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether it is the current INPROGRESS stage or the most recently updated stage.

columns.name: GENAI_UPDATED_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N flag to indicate whether the row is updated by Gen AI or not.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).
